question: Which plan is our workspace on, and can we use SSO?

model.source: recorded from openai/gpt-oss-120b through the openai provider

replies.text:
Your workspace **Kitewood Studio** is on the **Business plan** (annual billing).  
Since the workspace is set up with Okta SSO, members must sign in using the SSO provider—not a password—so you can use SSO for access【help:sign-in@6#3】.
